race.comment: I COULD DO BETTER (11) struck at the second run for the new stable when he defeated a key rival here in OCTAHEDRON. Doesn't have the same advantage at the barriers this time, out in 11 after starting from 1 last time, but he's a reliable performer who has to go in everything. OCTAHEDRON (4) draws better than I COULD DO BETTER this time around, so he's a big chance to turn the tables. HE'S ELECTRIC (3) broke the maiden at start No 17 last time out, so rises in grade here but should still be on the up and can take the next step. BLACK RUTILE (2) can't win off the last start, but was good the start prior and should get every chance from the inside alley. TUDAYA (9) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start when he was never in contention over 2000m at this track, beaten 6 lengths into seventh. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot find winning ways.
